pinned_dependency_inspection.default_collector: src/default.rs owns the default Collector in a process-global OnceLock and registers thread-local LocalHandles.
pinned_dependency_inspection.thread_exit: src/internal.rs Local::finalize moves deferred work to the global queue and marks the local entry deleted; entry finalization itself uses deferred destruction.
pinned_dependency_inspection.reclamation_contract: src/guard.rs documents no exact execution-time guarantee for deferred functions or destructors; flush may move deferred work to the global cache rather than execute it immediately.
pinned_dependency_inspection.implication: Joining worker threads does not by itself promise immediate reclamation of all epoch-managed allocations. A forced flush loop would not establish that promise.
pinned_dependency_inspection.limit: This lifecycle inspection is consistent with the observed retained stacks but does not prove every possible-loss record is harmless or provide a general memory bound.
